q_en: What should a senior candidate proactively dive into for Dropbox? (Select all that apply)
optionExplanations: 直传对象存储避免后端代理大字节，是处理大文件传输绕不开的第一层优化。
50GB 文件的复杂度基本都压在这里——分片、断点续传和服务端校验合起来才能把可靠性做扎实。
这些是传输和同步路径上更深一层的优化，能进一步压缩延迟和带宽消耗。
把文件放在应用服务器本地磁盘，扩容和容灾都无从谈起，直接违背高可用、可靠这条核心目标。
optionExplanations_en: Uploading directly to object storage avoids proxying large bytes off the application server — the first optimization layer for handling huge uploads.
Most of the complexity of a 50GB file lives here — chunking, resumability, and server-side verification together make it reliable.
These are further tuning steps on the transfer and sync path that squeeze out more latency and bandwidth.
Putting files on the app server's local disk rules out scaling and disaster recovery, directly violating this design's core high-availability goal.
scenario: Dropbox 面试只有 45 分钟，Senior 候选人的基础 API 和元数据模型必须快速带过。
scenario_en: The Dropbox interview is only 45 minutes, so a senior candidate has to move fast through the basic API and metadata model.

scenario: Dropbox 把分享关系从「文件里的 sharelist + 反向缓存双写」改成规范化的 SharedFiles 表（userId 分区键、fileId 排序键），不再维护 sharelist。
scenario_en: Dropbox replaces the inline sharelist plus inverse-cache dual-write with a normalized SharedFiles table (userId partition key, fileId sort key) and drops the sharelist.
q: 这次规范化换来了什么、代价是什么？
q_en: What does normalizing to a SharedFiles table gain, and what does it cost?
options: shared-with-me 查询会退化成对全量 FileMetadata 的顺序扫描，更慢了
查询改走复合键索引，比单键 KV 略慢，但换掉了 sharelist 的双写同步
fileId 从此不能作为主键一部分，复合主键的查询能力被削弱
规范化后无法再对下载请求做基于分享关系的权限校验
options_en: Shared-with-me queries degrade into a sequential scan over all FileMetadata, which is slower.
Queries move to a composite-key index, a bit slower than a single-key KV read, but the sharelist dual-write is gone.
fileId can no longer be part of the primary key, weakening composite-key queries.
After normalizing you can no longer authorize downloads based on the share relationship.
why: 规范化后 SharedFiles 是唯一真相，不用再同步 sharelist；代价是查询走复合键索引，比单键 KV 查找略慢。
why_en: Normalizing to one SharedFiles table removes the sharelist dual-write, so nothing can drift; the cost is an indexed lookup slightly slower than a single-key KV read.
tradeoff: 单一真相省掉双写同步 vs 复合键索引查询比 KV 单键略慢
optionExplanations: 去掉反向缓存不等于退回全表扫描——SharedFiles 用 userId 做分区键，查询仍是有索引的定位。
复合键（userId+fileId）走索引比纯单键 KV 稍慢，但不用再把 sharelist 和缓存两处写对齐。
fileId 正是排序键，复合主键的查询能力完整保留，这条说反了。
SharedFiles 表本身就是 ACL 来源，权限照常校验，只是查法从 KV 换成了索引。
optionExplanations_en: Dropping the inverse cache doesn't revert to a full scan — SharedFiles partitions by userId, so lookups stay indexed.
A composite key (userId+fileId) index is a touch slower than a pure single-key KV read, but there's no sharelist and cache to keep aligned.
fileId is exactly the sort key, so composite-key query power is fully retained — this gets it backwards.
The SharedFiles table is itself the ACL source, so authorization still works; only the lookup shape changed from KV to index.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由两列共同组成的主键，如 userId 做分区键、fileId 做排序键。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A composite key is a primary key formed by two columns together, e.g. userId as partition key and fileId as sort key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值查找：用单一键直接定位一条记录，通常是 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A key-value lookup locates one record directly by a single key, typically O(1).

termDefinitions.meaning: 访问控制列表：记录谁能访问某资源的授权表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An access control list records which users are authorized to access a resource.

scenario: Dropbox 用 CDN 缓存下载。某文件被用户更新或删除后，离用户最近的边缘节点上仍留着旧副本，新请求还能命中旧内容。
scenario_en: Dropbox caches downloads on a CDN. After a file is updated or deleted, the nearest edge node still holds the old copy and new requests keep hitting stale content.
q: 怎样让边缘上的旧副本失效？
q_en: How do you invalidate the stale copy sitting on the edge?
options: 靠 signed URL 到期自动清除，URL 一过期边缘副本就跟着没了
重启全部 CDN 边缘节点，强制清空它们上面的所有缓存
发 invalidation 让指定路径失效，或等短 TTL 到期
删掉 S3 源文件，CDN 会立即感知并同步移除对应边缘副本
options_en: Rely on signed-URL expiry — once the URL expires the edge copy vanishes with it.
Restart every CDN edge node to force-clear all of the caches on them.
Issue an invalidation for that path, or wait for a short TTL to lapse.
Delete the S3 origin file and the CDN instantly notices and removes the matching edge copy.
why: 边缘按 cache-control 的时长缓存副本；文件变更后要主动清除目标路径的边缘副本，或等它自然过期，代价是主动清除有传播延迟与调用成本。
why_en: The edge caches per its cache-control TTL, so after a change you either issue an explicit invalidation for that path or wait for the TTL to lapse — invalidation costs API calls and takes time to propagate.
tradeoff: 主动 invalidation 即时但有成本 vs 靠短 TTL 自然过期便宜但有陈旧窗口
optionExplanations: signed URL 过期只是让那条 URL 不能再用，边缘上缓存的文件字节不会因此被清掉。
重启边缘会把所有缓存一起清空，代价过大，也不是针对单个文件的失效手段。
发 invalidation 精确命中要清的那条路径，再配短 TTL 让其余副本自己老去，成本与新鲜度都可控。
删源文件后，边缘在 TTL 到期或被 invalidate 前仍会继续端出旧副本，不会即时同步。
optionExplanations_en: Signed-URL expiry only stops that one URL from working; the cached bytes at the edge aren't purged by it.
Restarting edges clears every cache at once — far too blunt, and not a per-file invalidation tool.
An explicit invalidation targets the exact path while a short TTL lets copies lapse on their own; together they control freshness.
After the origin is deleted, the edge keeps serving the stale copy until the TTL lapses or an invalidation hits — no instant sync.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存失效：主动通知 CDN 让某路径的边缘副本作废，下次请求回源重取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cache invalidation tells the CDN to purge an edge copy for a path so the next request refetches from origin.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 响应头，指定内容可缓存多久（含 max-age/TTL）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cache-control is an HTTP response header that sets how long content may be cached, including its max-age/TTL.

termDefinitions.meaning: 存活时间：缓存副本在自动过期前保留的时长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is how long a cached copy is kept before it automatically expires.

termDefinitions.meaning: 签名 URL：带签名和过期时间的临时访问链接，控制谁能取内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A signed URL is a temporary link carrying a signature and expiry that controls who may fetch the content.

q: 把 CDN 首次未命中时的回源填充路径排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the CDN cache-miss origin-fill path in the right order.
steps: S3 把文件字节返回给该边缘节点
用户请求文件，就近的 CDN 边缘节点收到请求
后续对同一文件的请求直接在边缘命中（cache hit），不再回源
边缘节点没有该文件副本（cache miss），回源向 S3 拉取
边缘节点缓存该文件并把它返回给用户
why: 首次请求边缘无副本（cache miss），回源到 S3 区域拉取并在边缘落地；之后同一文件的请求直接命中边缘，不再跨区回源。代价：第一个用户要承担一次回源延迟。
why_en: The first request misses at the edge, so the CDN fetches from the S3 origin and stores it; later requests hit the edge without crossing regions — the first user just eats one origin round-trip.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] --> Edge[CDN edge]
Edge -->|cache miss| S3[(S3 origin)]
S3 --> Edge
Edge -->|cache hit| Client

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存未命中：边缘节点没有请求的内容，需回源拉取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cache miss means the edge node lacks the requested content and must fetch it from origin.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存命中：边缘节点已有内容，直接返回，无需回源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cache hit means the edge node already has the content and serves it directly without going to origin.

termDefinitions.meaning: origin fetch：边缘节点向源站（这里是 S3）拉取内容的动作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Origin fetch is when an edge node pulls content from the origin, here S3.

scenario: Dropbox 最终架构里，应用服务器前面有一层 LB & API Gateway。你要决定 SSL termination、限流（rate limiting）、请求基本校验这几件横切关注点放在哪一层。
scenario_en: In Dropbox's final architecture an LB & API Gateway sits in front of the app servers. You must decide where SSL termination, rate limiting, and basic request validation belong.
q: 这些横切关注点应落在哪？
q_en: Which layer should these cross-cutting concerns live on?
options: 放进 File Service 业务逻辑里，每个 handler 各自实现一遍
放在 LB & API Gateway 层，统一在入口处理
下推到 S3，由对象存储在写入时执行
交给客户端 sync agent 在本地完成
options_en: Inside File Service business logic, reimplemented in each handler.
At the LB & API Gateway layer, handled once at the entry point.
Pushed down to S3, enforced by object storage on write.
Handed to the client sync agent to do locally.
why: SSL 终止、限流、请求校验对每个请求都一样，放在入口网关统一做，让 File Service 专注业务；代价是网关成必经点，要保证其可用与扩容。
why_en: SSL termination, rate limiting, and validation apply to every request, so doing them once at the gateway keeps File Service focused on business logic — at the cost of the gateway being a must-pass point to keep available.
whenOtherWins: 当鉴权要细到 per-file ACL 这种业务级校验时，那部分判断仍得落在 File Service，网关只做粗粒度校验。
tradeoff: 入口统一处理横切关注点 vs 网关成为必经瓶颈
optionExplanations: 每个 handler 各写一遍限流和 TLS，重复且容易不一致，正是网关层要消灭的重复。
这三件事每个请求都要过一遍，集中到入口做一次，下游业务服务就不用各自操心了。
S3 只负责存字节，做不了也不该承担限流和 SSL 终止这类入口职责。
客户端不可信，把限流/校验交给它等于没有校验，必须在服务端入口做。
optionExplanations_en: Reimplementing TLS and rate limiting in every handler is duplicated and drift-prone — exactly what the gateway layer exists to remove.
SSL termination, rate limiting, and validation are done once at the entry gateway, which every request passes through, keeping the business tier clean.
S3 only stores bytes; it can't and shouldn't take on entry-point duties like rate limiting or SSL termination.
The client is untrusted, so handing it rate limiting/validation is the same as no validation — it must happen at the server entry.

termDefinitions.meaning: SSL 终止：在入口处解密 HTTPS 流量，内部再用明文或内网 TLS 转发。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SSL termination decrypts HTTPS traffic at the entry point, forwarding it internally in plaintext or over internal TLS.

termDefinitions.meaning: 限流：限制单位时间内每个客户端可发的请求数，防止滥用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rate limiting caps how many requests a client may send per unit time to prevent abuse.

termDefinitions.meaning: API 网关：应用前的统一入口，处理路由、鉴权、限流等横切关注点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An API Gateway is a unified entry in front of the app that handles routing, auth, and rate limiting.

termDefinitions.meaning: 访问控制列表：记录谁能访问某资源的授权表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An access control list records which users are authorized to access a resource.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同步代理：客户端上监听本地改动并与远端同步的后台程序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sync agent is a client-side background process that watches local changes and syncs them with the remote.

scenario: 客户端要上传一个 4GB 的 H.264 视频（或一张已编码的 PNG），这类媒体已是压缩格式，再压体积几乎不变，却要吃 CPU 时间。
scenario_en: The client is uploading a 4GB H.264 video (or an already-encoded PNG); such media is already compressed, so recompressing barely shrinks it yet costs CPU time.
q: 上传前该压缩吗？
q_en: Should the client compress this media before uploading?
options: 压缩，任何文件压完都会明显变小，一律压总没错
不压，已压过的媒体再压几乎没收益
让后端先解码再重压，能榨出更高的压缩比
改成先加密再压缩，据说这样能提高压缩率
options_en: Compress it — any file shrinks noticeably, so always compressing is safe.
Skip it — recompressing already-encoded media barely helps.
Decode it on the backend first, then recompress to squeeze out a higher ratio.
Encrypt first, then compress, which supposedly raises the compression ratio.
why: 视频/PNG 已是压缩编码，压缩比接近 1，省不下几个字节却要花压/解压时间；只有文本这类高压缩比文件才值得客户端压。
why_en: Video and PNG are already compressed, so the ratio is near 1 — you burn CPU compressing but save almost no bytes; only high-ratio files like text are worth compressing on the client.
whenOtherWins: 换成 5GB 文本文件时压缩比很高（可能压到 1GB 以下），此时客户端压缩省下的传输时间远超压缩耗时。
tradeoff: 压缩省下的传输字节 vs 压/解压花掉的 CPU 时间
optionExplanations: 已压缩的媒体再压几乎不变小，一律压缩只是白费 CPU，这条把文本和媒体一概而论了。
H.264/PNG 已是压缩格式，再压体积几乎不动，省下的字节抵不上压/解压时间。
后端解码再压意味着完整文件先传了一遍，还把后端拖进数据路径，得不偿失。
加密会把数据搅成近随机，之后再压几乎无规律可压——顺序反了，应先压后加密。
optionExplanations_en: Recompressing already-compressed media barely shrinks it, so always compressing just wastes CPU — this lumps text and media together.
H.264/PNG are already compressed, so recompressing hardly moves the size and the saved bytes don't cover the compress/decompress time.
Decoding on the backend to recompress means the full file already crossed the wire and drags the backend into the data path — a net loss.
Encrypting first turns data near-random, leaving compression nothing to work with — the order is reversed; compress before encrypt.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种广泛使用的视频压缩编码标准，输出已是压缩数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: H.264 is a widely used video compression codec whose output is already compressed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种无损图像格式，文件本身已经过压缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PNG is a lossless image format whose files are already compressed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 原始大小与压缩后大小之比，越高越省字节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Compression ratio is original size over compressed size; higher means more bytes saved.

scenario: Dropbox 的压缩在客户端做，需要压/解压都快且压缩比不差，算法由客户端而非浏览器决定。要在 Gzip、Brotli、Zstandard 里选一个默认算法。
scenario_en: Dropbox compresses on the client, needs fast compress and decompress with a decent ratio, and the client (not the browser) picks the algorithm. Choose a default among Gzip, Brotli, and Zstandard.
q: 默认选哪个更合适？
q_en: Which is the better default here?
options: Gzip，兼容性最广、哪都能解，但压缩比偏低
Brotli，文本压缩比通常高于 Gzip，浏览器都支持
Zstandard，压/解压都快且压缩比不差，速度/比率可调
无脑选压缩比最高的，速度多慢都无所谓
options_en: Gzip — the broadest compatibility, decodable anywhere, but a lower ratio.
Brotli — usually a higher text ratio than Gzip, and all browsers support it.
Zstandard — fast to compress and decompress with a solid ratio, tunable speed/ratio.
Just pick the highest ratio, no matter how slow it is.
why: 客户端压缩既要压得快又要解得快，Zstandard 在相近压缩比下压/解压都明显快于 Gzip，且速度/比率可调；代价是生态兼容性不如 Gzip 普及。
why_en: Client-side compression needs fast compress and decompress; Zstandard is markedly faster than Gzip at comparable ratios and is tunable — the tradeoff is it's less universally available than Gzip.
tradeoff: 压缩比/速度平衡 vs Gzip 的最广兼容性
optionExplanations: Gzip 到处能解、最保险，但压缩比偏低；只有当兼容性压倒一切时才为它牺牲比率。
Brotli 文本压缩比常高于 Gzip，但压缩偏慢；若上传以文本为主、能容忍慢一点它更合适。
Zstandard 压/解压都快、压缩比不差，还能按需调速度/比率，最贴合客户端压缩场景。
只盯压缩比会忽略压/解压耗时，慢算法可能把省下的传输时间又赔回去。
optionExplanations_en: Gzip decodes everywhere and is the safest bet, but its ratio is low; only trade ratio for it when compatibility dominates.
Brotli often beats Gzip on text ratio but compresses slowly; it fits when uploads are mostly text and some slowness is tolerable.
Zstandard is fast both ways with a solid ratio and tunable speed/ratio, which best fits client-side compression.
Fixating on ratio ignores compress/decompress time; a slow algorithm can give back the transfer time it saved.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最广泛使用的通用压缩算法，兼容性极好但压缩比偏低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Gzip is the most widely used general-purpose compressor: great compatibility, lower ratio.

termDefinitions.meaning: 谷歌开发的压缩算法，文本压缩比常高于 Gzip，压缩偏慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Brotli, from Google, often achieves a higher text ratio than Gzip but compresses more slowly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 压/解压都很快、压缩比不错且速度/比率可调的压缩算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Zstandard is a compressor that is fast both ways, has a good ratio, and lets you tune speed versus ratio.
